page.layout: One column of running text, with marginal notes in the right margin. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Signature at the foot left, with a small mark at the foot right. Text ends mid-sentence at the foot.

main_text.p: restituitur) quam quidem in-ferendam, & impendentem.4. Quia qui primùm ictum exspectat, & excipit, se objicit maximo discrimini, si non vitæ, saltem mutilationis corporis & membrorum. In tantùm, ut etiam in posterum brachio forte trajecto, vel aliâ corporis parte læsâ, minus reddatur idoneus, semet adversus truculentum adversarium defendendi. Tumque nihil ipsi relliquum[?] foret, nisi ut ab ad-versario indignis modis tractaretur, etiam ad ejusdem lubitum tandem occideretur. Proinde jura permittunt, l. 1. Cod. Quando cuique lic. sine jud,ut malo nascenti tempestivè occurratur, ne post causam de-sperata-m, remedia frustra quę-rantur. Idque ex illo trito: Principiis obsta; sero medicina pa-ratur.
Neque hisce obstat. {r}Quodl. 52. §. r. D. Ad leg. Aquil. Alfenus jurisconsultus alibi

page.notes: Uncertain readings: "relliquum" (marked [?]); the page number "155" is hard to make out and is marked [?]. Possible printing error: "de-sperata-m" is set as printed with the line break at "de-" and "m" at the next line; I have transcribed it as the printed hyphenation of "desperatam". The mark "{r}" in the text corresponds to the margin note "§. r.". At the foot right there is a small mark "I6-" that is not clearly a catchword, so it is left out. The margin note "1. 1. Cod." is read as "l. 1." with a Latin l. The note of two lines in the margin, "1.52. §.r. D. Ad leg. A-quil.", is run together as "Aquil." in the transcription.
